jobs.title: Social Media-Manager (m/w/d) - Remote
jobs.description: Du möchtest etwas Neues lernen und suchst einen Arbeitsplatz, bei dem du flexibel arbeiten kannst? Dann starte jetzt im Bereich Social Media und KI-Management durch. Ganz egal, ob in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit. Schritt 1: Die Schulung Wir bereiten dich auf diesen Beruf vor. Lerne mit uns die erforderlichen Kenntnisse und werde zum Experten für Social Media und Künstliche Intelligenz. Die Schulung kannst du ganz bequem online von zu Hause aus erledigen, mit flexibler Zeiteinteilung und innerhalb weniger Wochen. Schritt 2: Die Arbeit Nach der Schulung bist du bereit zu starten. Entscheide selber, welcher Arbeitsbereich dir am besten gefällt und zu dir und deiner persönlichen Situation passt. Sowohl von den Aufgaben als auch der Arbeitszeiten. Über Digital Evolution AI Wir sind ein Schulungsanbieter und begleiten dich auf deinem Weg in einen neuen beruflichen Bereich. Du startest bei uns mit einer Weiterbildung und erhältst anschließend Zugang zu verschiedenen Jobangeboten, die zu deiner aktuellen Situation passen. So begleiten wir dich von der Schulung bis zum Berufseinstieg. Unser Ziel ist es, das notwendige Fachwissen zu vermitteln, um langfristig erfolgreich im Bereich Social Media und KI-Management arbeiten zu können. Unser Schulungsprogramm richtet sich sowohl an Quereinsteiger, die etwas Neues lernen und ihren Berufsweg verändern möchten, als auch an Personen mit ersten Vorkenntnissen. Die Schulung kann einfach und flexibel online absolviert werden. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC
jobs.description: This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 12 month FTC.   Role Summary PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively.  We re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team for a 12-month maternity cover contract. It s an interesting time to join us.   Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn t exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we re rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.   That means there are interesting product  problems  to solve - not just features to deliver.   You ll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.   Although this is a fixed-term role, it isn t a caretaker role. You ll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.   How we work   We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.   We don t expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.   You ll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.   You ll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen. Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 📱 Our Product Team Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams. Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value: Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team. Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app. Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell. jobs.title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
jobs.description: Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning.  Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge. Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success. Your responsibilities will include: Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning. Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system. Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization. Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking. Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research

jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake. jobs.title: Credit Manager (H/F)
jobs.description: Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé. Nous collectons, trions et valorisons les déchets de chantier des professionnels du BTP en Île-de-France et dans le Sud : Big Bags, bennes, apport sur site, et une plateforme digitale propriétaire qui pilote nos flux en temps réel. Le groupe réalise 20 M€ de chiffre d’affaires, compte 25 personnes dans ses bureaux de Paris 15e, et grandit par croissance organique et par acquisitions. Nous créons le poste de Credit Manager. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout. Votre mission Faire en sorte que chacune de nos prestations se transforme en cash, vite et proprement. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier. Le travail répétitif est déjà automatisé : chaque matin, un agent IA prépare votre liste d’appels priorisée, suit les promesses de paiement et surveille les procédures collectives. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision. Ce que vous ferez Appeler chaque jour vos clients, obtenir des engagements de paiement datés et chiffrés, et les faire tenir. Traiter les litiges à la racine avec nos équipes Opérations, Planning et Expérience Client. Animer le comité de crédit hebdomadaire : comptes à bloquer, à débloquer, conditions de paiement. Mener les mises en demeure, les injonctions de payer et les déclarations de créance. Suivre vos indicateurs : cash encaissé, délai de paiement, échu à plus de 90 jours. Faire progresser le dispositif avec l’agent IA, et former nos commerciaux au réflexe « se faire payer ». Votre profil 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en recouvrement B2B ou en credit management, idéalement auprès de PME, dans le BTP ou les services. Une vraie aisance au téléphone : ferme sur le fond, courtois sur la forme.

jobs.title: Ph.D. Researcher. Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps
jobs.description: Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology About the Position The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks. Key objectives include: Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps. Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge. Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning. Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction. The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge , supporting both individual users and collaborative communities. Deine Aufgaben sind immer klar vorgegeben, und es gibt immer nur den nächsten Schritt zu vereinbaren, und wenn der Kunde ausbrechen wollen würde, gibt es einen Plan B, der auch klar ist :-) Es ist soooo nice simple, dass es einfach nur Laune bringt. Strukturen lieben

jobs.description: Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale. Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution. Tu rejoins l'équipe SDR, et ton objectif principal sera d'accompagner et de convaincre nos prospects à poursuivre le processus de vente en organisant des rendez-vous avec les Account Executives. En tant que SDR, tu représentes le premier contact client, tu es le premier maillon de notre processus de vente ; ainsi, tu participes activement à l'atteinte de nos objectifs commerciaux. En rejoignant le département Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions : En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR). jobs.title: Automonteur
jobs.description: Heb jij ervaring met het onderhouden en repareren van personenauto’s? Werk je graag met moderne diagnoseapparatuur en wil je jezelf verder ontwikkelen? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou als Automonteur! Via Bommel Uitzendbureau ga je aan de slag bij een professionele dealerorganisatie in Maastricht. Deze organisatie maakt deel uit van een grote Europese automotivegroep en verzorgt de verkoop en het onderhoud van personenauto’s. Je werkt in een moderne werkplaats aan personenauto’s van verschillende bekende automerken. Samen met betrokken collega’s zorg je ervoor dat klanten veilig en tevreden de weg op gaan. Als Automonteur krijg je afwisselende werkzaamheden die aansluiten bij jouw opleiding en ervaring. Wat je gaat doen · Uitvoeren van onderhoud, reparaties en technische aanpassingen aan personenauto’s; · Opsporen en verhelpen van storingen met moderne test- en diagnoseapparatuur; · Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden aan onder meer motoren en automatische versnellingsbakken; · Afleverklaar maken van nieuwe en gebruikte auto’s; · Overleggen met de diagnosetechnicus bij complexe technische problemen; · Oppakken van complexere reparaties en ondersteunen van collega’s wanneer je als eerste autotechnicus aan de slag gaat; · Uitvoeren van APK-keuringen als je hiervoor bevoegd bent. Wat wij vragen · Een afgeronde opleiding op minimaal MBO-2 niveau in de autotechniek; · Een diploma op MBO-3 niveau wanneer je als eerste autotechnicus aan de slag wilt; · Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse of Engelse taal; · Een geldig rijbewijs B; · Een nauwkeurige en zelfstandige werkhouding; · Technisch inzicht, initiatief en plezier in het oplossen van problemen; · Het vermogen om goed samen te werken met collega’s. Wat wij bieden · Een salaris van € 2.600 tot € 3.800 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, ervaring en eventuele APK-bevoegdheid; · Een fulltimebaan voor 40 uur per week, waarbij 32 of 36 uur bespreekbaar is; · 24 vakantiedagen bij een fullt

Du nutzt KI-Tools, um Kundenkommunikation, Auswertungen und deine Arbeitsabläufe effizienter zu gestal

jobs.description: Über Jurata Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Der Legal Agent übernimmt Recherche, Drafting und die Überarbeitung von Dokumenten und belegt seine Antworten mit Millionen verifizierter Erlasse, Gerichtsentscheide und weiterer relevanter Quellen. Entwickelt in der Schweiz, von Juristen für Juristen. Der Legal Agent ist täglich bei tausenden Legal Professionals im Einsatz, von führenden Kanzleien über Rechtsabteilungen renommierter Unternehmen bis hin zu Schaden- und Rechtsteams grosser Versicherungen wie der Mobiliar und Protekta. Weil die Nachfrage nach der Lösung stark wächst, bauen wir nun unser Sales- und Business-Development-Team gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Rolle KI verändert gerade fundamental, wie Juristinnen und Juristen arbeiten, und in dieser Rolle bist du mittendrin. Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent in unserem Sales- und Business-Development-Team in Zürich bringst du den Jurata Legal Agent zu Anwältinnen, Kanzleipartnern, General Counsels und AI Leads in Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe, zeigst in Demos, was KI in ihrem Arbeitsalltag konkret verändern kann, und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch über den Vertragsabschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding. Du startest nicht bei null: Du erhältst ein bewährtes Setup mit Playbooks, qualifizierten Kundenanfragen und Coaching durch das Team. Gleichzeitig trägst du früh Verantwortung für eigene Ergebnisse und siehst direkt, was du zum Wachstum von Jurata beiträgst. Deine Aufgaben Du kontaktierst Kanzleien, Rechtsabteilungen und weitere juristische Organisationen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst Termine. Du bearbeitest eingehende, qualifizierte Kundenanfragen und findest heraus, wo der Legal Agent konkreten Mehrwert schafft. Du zeigst live, was der Legal Agent kann, und überzeugst juristische Fachpersonen in Produktdemos mit deiner juristischen Kompetenz und echten Fällen aus der Praxis. Du begleites

jobs.title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Teaching Socials Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden. Deine Aufgaben Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab. Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst. Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist. Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück. Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser. Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen. Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt. jobs.description: Unternehmen Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH ist Teil der PolymerCycle Gruppe und spezialisiert auf die Regranulierung und das Recompounding technischer Kunststoffe. Die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH liefert ihre Produkte an höchst anspruchsvolle Kundenindustrien – wie die Automobilbranche, Elektro-/Elektronik oder Haushaltsgeräte – zuverlässig und nach strengen Qualitätsanforderungen. Dafür greift die Hoffmann+Voss GmbH auf langjährige Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung und Compoundierung von technischen Kunststoffen zurück. Mit einem vollumfänglichen, modern ausgestatteten Labor bietet Hoffmann+Voss umfassende Analytik-, Prüf- und Entwicklungsleistungen. In der Gruppe bündeln die Unternehmen der PolymerCycle Gruppe ihren Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Rohstoffströmen, ihre Expertise in komplexen Kundenindustrien, umfangreiche Produktionskapazitäten sowie tiefes technologisches und materialwissenschaftliches Know-how. Durch die Kombination von Sortier-, Trenn-, Regranulierungs- und Compounding-Know-how entstehen hochwertige Recyclinglösungen, die sowohl technische Anforderungen erfüllen als auch die wachsende europäische Nachfrage nach qualitätsgesicherten Rezyklaten bedienen. Für das Werk der Hoffmann+Voss GmbH in Viersen suchen wir einen Leiter Operations (m/w/d). jobs.description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the Role Getting finished collars from our factories to the right market, at the right time and at the right cost, is one of the most commercially critical things Halter does. Get it wrong and markets run short while others sit on excess stock, freight costs creep up, and customers wait. As Global Inventory Planner, you’ll make sure that doesn’t happen. You’ll own the flow of finished goods from factory to market against the plan, hold stock on hand in every market and warehouse to target, and own our international freight from factory to destination. You’ll be deep in the details: projecting where stock will be in every warehouse weeks ahead, planning what ships where and when, managing forwarder performance and cost, and spotting where a market will drift from target early enough to act. jobs.title: (Senior) Softwareentwickler (m/w/x) Testautomatisierung
jobs.description: Projektbeschreibung: Technologie begeistert Sie? Uns auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Funk- und Kommunikationsbranche suchen wir einen (Senior) Softwareentwickler (m/w/x) Testautomatisierung in Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie persönlich kennen zu lernen - und gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft und Teamgeist an spannenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien zu arbeiten. Aufgaben: Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst eine zentrale Testautomatisierungsplattform für komplexe Funkkommunikationssysteme. Du entwickelst die Softwarearchitektur und Automatisierungslogik für ein übergeordnetes End-to-End-Testsystem und treibst dessen Weiterentwicklung voran. Du implementierst CI/CD-basierte Testabläufe, beispielsweise mit Jenkins oder GitLab CI, zur kontinuierlichen Systemverifikation. Du erstellst und pflegst Schnittstellen, APIs und Protokolle zum zu testenden System sowie zu angebundenen Messgeräten, Testständen und externen Systemen. Du entwickelst Lösungen zur automatisierten Erfassung, Ablage, Auswertung und Visualisierung von Mess- und Testergebnissen. jobs.description: Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale. Role Overview This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs. You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number. The role is deliberately hands on . You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you. Why this role is exciting You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck. You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness. jobs.description: About Humify GmbH Humify is an innovative start-up developing a novel technology to convert biomass into valuable humic substances. Our mission is to improve soil fertility, support sustainable agriculture, and contribute to long-term carbon storage. We are a small, international team of scientists and engineers working to bring this technology from the laboratory to industrial production. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys practical technical work, solving mechanical problems, and experimenting with new technologies. Your responsibilities Equipment operation: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain a laboratory- or pilot-scale extruder for biomass processing. Experimental support: Prepare biomass feedstocks, conduct extrusion trials, collect samples, and document results. Equipment assembly and modification: Assemble, adjust, and improve mechanical components, feeding systems, screw configurations, and other process equipment. Maintenance and troubleshooting: Identify and resolve mechanical and operational problems, perform routine maintenance, and minimize equipment downtime. Process monitoring: Monitor operating parameters such as temperature, pressure, screw speed, feed rate, and material flow. Workshop activities: Support the construction of prototypes, installation of sensors, and modification of experimental equipment. Documentation: Record operating parameters, maintenance activities, and experimental observations. Safety and organization: Maintain a safe, clean, and well-organized technical workspace. jobs.title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
jobs.description: TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. jobs.description: Introduction Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage. As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap. What you'll do Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality. Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog. Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively. Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage. Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape. The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture. Location : Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone. jobs.description: About Deepdesk Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside. At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks. You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets. We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go. We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden. jobs.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
jobs.description: Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later. About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle. The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours. It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields. jobs.description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
